MATCH (t:Team)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WHERE CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) > 1967
   OR t.team_name <> 'Charlotte Hornets'
   OR t.team_name = 'Detroit Pistons'
   OR CAST(t.founded_year AS INT64) >= 1989
WITH DISTINCT t
OPTIONAL MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t)
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, t.founded_year AS col2, o.name AS col3, t.team_name AS name_team
